subject: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — proposal, dates, and enablement checklist
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@velocity-consulting.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: tom.yates@factoryplan.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — Proposal & pilot dates

Hi Logan / Camila,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — Velocity is excited to pilot a short-form "Accelerator Bootcamp" built to get two integrator teams (our consultants + 1 of your SI partners) productive on Redwood Inference in 2–3 days.

High-level ask: can Redwood host a 2.5 day technical bootcamp (half-day intro, 2 days hands-on labs + mentor pairing) for Nov 30–Dec 2 or Dec 7–9? Objectives:
- End-to-end deployment of a sample LLM pipeline (hosted -> dedicated -> private flow)
- Run inference cost/latency experiments and review quantization suggestions
- Playbook handoff and mentor pairing for first 60 days

I've attached a short outline (Velocity-Accelerator-Outline.pdf) and a preliminary mutual action plan we can refine. Practical asks on our side: a sandbox API key, ephemeral dedicated node access for the labs, and a brief SOC2 / audit checklist to share with our procurement.

Tom (cc) will be the implementation lead from our side. Can you confirm capacity and any preferred date window?

Cheers,
Nina Patel
Partner Lead, Velocity Consulting
Attachment: Velocity-Accelerator-Outline.pdf (PDF)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@velocity-consulting.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — Proposal & pilot dates

Nina — appreciate the clear ask and the outline. Nov 30–Dec 2 works on our side for an internal instructor cohort; Dec 7–9 is also possible if you need extra lead time.

Quick notes / next steps from Redwood:
- We can allocate a sandbox API key + short-lived dedicated instance for the hands-on lab. I'll have Partner Ops create the token and temp clusters.
- Please send over the Procurement/Security checklist items you need — we maintain a short SOC2 evidence pack and an integration checklist.
- Camila — can you confirm instructor availability and whether we want a mixed live/recorded session format? Jordan, please flag any existing playbook templates we should reuse.

Logistics ask for Velocity: are you expecting remote-only or hybrid? Also, please share an attendee list (roles) so we can tailor the lab exercises.

I can put a short MoAP together and share a calendar hold once we lock dates.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0123

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@velocity-consulting.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, tom.yates@factoryplan.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T07:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — Proposal & pilot dates

Thanks Logan — remote-only is fine for the pilot. Attendees (provisional):
- Tom Yates (implementation lead)
- Priya Suresh (senior data engineer)
- Aaron Mills (solutions architect)
- 4 consultants in associate/consultant roles for hands-on labs

Attached is a suggested MoAP (Pilot-MoAP-2026.xlsx) that maps outcomes to owners + acceptance criteria. We also included a procurement note requesting SOC2 Type II evidence + a short list of required network endpoints.

A couple of clarifying questions:
1) For the ephemeral dedicated node — what quota/policy governs peak token throughput?
2) Can mentors access customer logs for the labs or do we need explicit consent steps?

If the questions are straightforward, we can confirm Nov 30–Dec 2 and request the sandbox credentials the week prior (Nov 23–25).

Nina
Attachment: Pilot-MoAP-2026.xlsx (Excel)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@velocity-consulting.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-16T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — Proposal & pilot dates

Hi team — looping in Marissa for enablement content + Jordan for lab ops. Answering Nina's questions inline:

> 1) For the ephemeral dedicated node — what quota/policy governs peak token throughput?
We can stand up a 2-GPU dedicated pool for the pilot with a soft cap we manage (we'll monitor token/sec and throttle if we hit SLOs). For the hands-on labs, that is more than enough to simulate typical customer workloads.

> 2) Can mentors access customer logs for the labs or do we need explicit consent steps?
Mentors can access logs generated in the sandbox environment (we control the cluster). For any real customer data we require explicit consent and a short data access agreement. We'll include a one-paragraph consent in the MoAP.

Action items I will take:
- Draft a 1-page instructor guide (roles, timing, lab artifacts) and share by Nov 20.
- Create sandbox API key + onboarding doc; target to hand to Velocity Nov 25.
- Draft a short mentor pairing roster and optional office-hours cadence.

Marissa — can you attach the latest "Integrator Playbook" skeleton to this thread so we can iterate?

Camila Reyes
Program Manager, Partner Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@velocity-consulting.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Accelerator Bootcamp — Proposal & pilot dates

Nina — locking Nov 30–Dec 2 for the pilot cohort. Confirmed next steps and owners below (short checklist):
- Velocity: confirm final attendee list by Nov 22 (owner: Nina).
- Redwood Partner Ops: issue sandbox API key + temporary dedicated instance by Nov 25 (owner: Logan / Jordan).
- Enablement: instructor guide and playbook draft to Velocity by Nov 20 (owner: Camila / Marissa).
- Legal/Procurement: SOC2 artifacts & short consent language to Velocity by Nov 24 (owner: Redwood Security).
- Logistics: DocuSign SOW for pilot (estimate: $0–$5k) — I'll send the PowerForm; please sign before Nov 25.

Attachments: integrator-bootcamp-playbook-v1.md (draft) — this is a first pass focused on outcomes, lab exercises, and mentor pairing. Please review and send comments in-line on the Drive link.

Calendar: I'll create a calendar series with daily agendas and office-hours slots. If any of your attendees have timezone constraints please flag them.

Thanks everyone — excited to run this.

— Logan
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: integrator-bootcamp-playbook-v1.md (Markdown)
